claim: Anchor decides token-required SOLELY by whether ANCHOR_TOKEN is set (auth_ok returns True when token is None); NO request peer/remote-address/Origin/CSRF check exists. The startup bind guard only refuses a DIRECT non-loopback bind without a token. So behind a same-box reverse proxy (Tailscale Serve) to a loopback-bound Anchor with ANCHOR_TOKEN unset, EVERY mutating POST /api/* (incl. the bypassPermissions build lane, an RCE-class surface) is reachable UNAUTHENTICATED by any tailnet device
note: Durable fix = mandatory auth decoupled from bind interface (fail-closed: require ANCHOR_TOKEN unless explicit insecure-local opt-in). A peer-IP check alone would NOT fix it — the proxied peer is always loopback.

claim: The DOCUMENTED remote path enable_remote.ps1 is SAFE: it always sets ANCHOR_TOKEN and binds ANCHOR_BIND=<tailscale-ip> directly (the startup guard backstops that). The gap in M1 is the UN-documented manual reverse-proxy path only

WebSockets through `tailscale serve` have an open reliability bug (#18827): connections drop every ~10-40s with close code 1001. Anchor terminals use WS (/api/rnd/term_ws) with an SSE-out+POST-in fallback (term_stream2/term_input2) and SSE long-poll for logs (/api/rnd/tail). Mitigation: prefer the SSE+POST fallback over Serve, or add a WS keepalive ping

iOS/iPadOS Safari requires an HTTPS secure context for service workers and a full installable PWA; http://<LAN-or-Tailscale-IP> is NOT a secure context (the localhost exception does not extend to IPs). Tailscale Serve provisions a real auto-renewed Let's Encrypt cert for the MagicDNS name (https://gwl-server.<tailnet>.ts.net) -> genuine secure context on the iPad with no cert warning

iOS NEVER shows an install prompt (no beforeinstallprompt); adding a home-screen app is MANUAL via Safari Share -> Add to Home Screen. As of iOS 26 added sites open standalone by default. You must teach the user / show a custom hint

For a clean iOS standalone home-screen app, recommended tags: apple-mobile-web-app-capable (+ alias mobile-web-app-capable), apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style, apple-mobile-web-app-title, and an OPAQUE 180x180 PNG apple-touch-icon (iOS uses apple-touch-icon for the home icon; SVG/transparency unreliable). A display:standalone manifest with id/start_url/scope is also honored (Safari 16.4+)

PRESENT today: only <link rel=apple-touch-icon href=/anchor-touch.png> on the MAIN dashboard; anchor-touch.png is a 180x180 opaque PNG (already the right size). ABSENT: web manifest, apple-mobile-web-app-capable/status-bar-style/title, and any apple/PWA tag on the project (cockpit) window

iOS standalone storage is ITP-restricted: script-writable storage (localStorage/IndexedDB/SW cache) is EVICTED after ~7 days of non-use and is SEPARATE from the Safari tab -> the classic 'logged out on reopen'. Anchor's ?token= / X-Anchor-Token is read from localStorage by the client JS, so a re-auth path is needed; this interacts with M1 (don't rely on a persisted token)

Anchor WS client JS is proxy-correct: wsProto = (location.protocol==='https:')?'wss:':'ws:' and URL built from location.host -> a page over https://...ts.net opens wss://...ts.net, NO mixed-content, NO hard-coded localhost. There is NO Origin check on the WS upgrade (works behind proxy; also nothing rejects cross-origin)

RESPONSIVE GAP: the MAIN dashboard has a viewport meta + ONE @media(max-width:768px) rule (hides sidebar, wraps stat cards). The PROJECT/COCKPIT window (render_project_window_html) has NO viewport meta and NO @media rules -> the 5-column Kanban renders at desktop width on a ~390px iPhone. The cockpit needs responsive work + viewport-fit=cover + env(safe-area-inset-*) for the notch

Backend can and SHOULD stay loopback-only behind Tailscale Serve (Tailscale recommends the origin listen on localhost only); this preserves Anchor's 127.0.0.1 default bind + SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE single-instance guard. Serve is tailnet-PRIVATE; Tailscale FUNNEL (public internet) must be AVOIDED

The migration plan ALREADY contemplates this exact path: tailscale serve --bg https / http://localhost:8777, an iPad Add-to-Home-Screen flow, and injecting the apple-touch-icon (the origin of the existing line). Tailnet DNS is tailb49f65.ts.net; HTTPS certs enabled
